name: Vampire
source: Vampires are blood-sucking demons that live in darkness and control the shadows. Her diet should naturally consist of blood. but instead she directly absorbs the life energy from her victims. Her ruby red lips provide intense pleasure as she drains out a man's life. Due to this ability she is called a life-sucking princess.
